{{- /* Working href for a commerce page. Garden/Foundry emits leaf pages as name.html, not name/index.html. relLangURL keeps the share prefix (/s/{siteId}/). */ -}} {{- $raw := . -}} {{- if not $raw -}}{{- $raw = "/privacy.html" -}}{{- end -}} {{- if or (eq $raw "/purchase/") (eq $raw "/purchase") (eq $raw "purchase") (eq $raw "purchase/") -}} {{- $raw = "/purchase.html" -}} {{- else if or (eq $raw "/pricing/") (eq $raw "/pricing") (eq $raw "pricing") (eq $raw "pricing/") -}} {{- $raw = "/pricing.html" -}} {{- else if or (eq $raw "/privacy/") (eq $raw "/privacy") (eq $raw "privacy") (eq $raw "privacy/") -}} {{- $raw = "/privacy.html" -}} {{- end -}} {{- $raw | relLangURL -}}
